name: Gyromast's Revenge
summary: Along Darkshore, Gelkak Gyromast seeks payback from the murlocs who plundered his wrecked ship. He sends you to reactivate his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100.

sections.title: A Captain's Vendetta
sections.body: Gelkak Gyromast is stranded on Darkshore, but he will not accept defeat by the shore-dwelling murlocs. He has salvaged the pieces needed for his scheme and now seeks revenge on the tribe and its chief. Rather than take up his cutlass and wade into the surf, the eccentric captain turns to engineering. He entrusts you with a winding key and asks you to handle his mechanical subordinate.

sections.title: The First Mate's Mutiny
sections.body: Gelkak's first mate is the Threshwackonator 4100, a clanking mechanical golem left in the shallows south of the wreck. The machine promises an easy slaughter of the murlocs, but proves dangerously unreliable. After you wind it up and lead it back to Gelkak, it malfunctions. The construct mistakes its rescuer and creator for hostile targets, forcing a battle on the beach.

faq.answer: Gelkak's first mate is the Threshwackonator 4100, an automated mechanical golem on the coast south of his stranded camp.

Gelkak's ship was wrecked along Darkshore, and the native Greymist murlocs rummaged through the wreckage and took part of his first mate's key. He means to use his golem against the tribe and its chief.

faq.q: What happens when you bring the Threshwackonator back?
faq.answer: Activate the Threshwackonator with Gelkak's key, then lead it back to him. What happens when it reaches the captain becomes clear during the escort.

faq.q: What do I do with Gyromast's Key after finishing the quest?
faq.answer: Gyromast's Key activates the Threshwackonator. Once the work is done, the key has no further purpose.

faq.q: Where did Gelkak get the Threshwackonator?
faq.answer: The Threshwackonator came with cargo and equipment salvaged from Gelkak's ill-fated voyage along northern Kalimdor. It was designed to provide heavy mechanical muscle for his crew.

faq.q: Does Gelkak give up after the golem is destroyed?
faq.answer: Gelkak's plans and response become clear when you bring his first mate back.

angles.text: Gelkak's mechanical first mate shows how much a stranded captain relies on engineering equipment.
As a gnome, you may recognize the winding key as a familiar way to activate a mechanical automaton.
As an Alliance traveler, you help clear malfunctioning machinery and aggressive murlocs from the coastline between Auberdine and the lands to the south.
